findings: All persistent jobs are owned by WorkManager; Aura does not retain JobParameters or implement JobService, so STOP_REASON_TIMEOUT_ABANDONED does not apply directly.
No CoroutineWorker calls setForeground or setForegroundAsync; Aura has no long-running WorkManager worker that consumes Android 16 quota through a worker-owned foreground service.
Ordinary and expedited WorkManager jobs consume quota when started while the app is TOP and while concurrent with a foreground service on Android 16.

RotationTriggerService can overlap rotation_trigger_oneshot; unique KEEP coalesces passive triggers, only explicit requests are expedited, and expedited quota exhaustion downgrades to ordinary work instead of dropping the request.

auto_wallpaper_catch_up is ordinary constrained work that WorkManager holds until its network constraint is met; the worker never retries or polls for a connection itself, and a catch-up never queues another.
Every CoroutineWorker rethrows CancellationException so WorkManager can complete stop handling without abandoned in-process work.
Settings and support diagnostics expose WorkInfo stop reasons, including QUOTA, TIMEOUT, and BACKGROUND_RESTRICTION.
